choice: Geometric centroid of each Chiang Mai district polygon, flagged when the centroid falls outside the polygon and an interior point is used instead.
rationale: No settlement or child-location layer is on disk. The optional health-office population Excel was IP-blocked, and DOPA December 2025 gives registration counts without coordinates. District is already the join geography for DOPA, DOLE and TPMAP. A centroid is an administrative proxy, not a child's home. Travel times describe that proxy. They are not a percentage of children within 30 or 60 minutes.

choice: Eight exact public sites that are current delivery or mixed office-and-delivery: CM-004 Thai Freedom House, CM-010 IMEMF, CM-022 Salvation Army, CM-026 Projects for Asia, CM-029 Wat Don Chan, CM-030 Dulabhatorn, CM-032 Radion, CM-071 Mae Rim children's and family shelter.
rationale: Road routing is applied only where a public house or building geocode exists. Protected homes, undisclosed sites and district-level approximations have no defensible door, so they are not routed to. Pure offices and the two former Mueang offices are organisation addresses, not the delivery destinations for this estimate. The juvenile centre is stored and labelled, and it stays outside the family-support destination set. All eight included sites are family-support relevant under the Level 2A rule.

choice: Primary: private-vehicle road distance and time from the FOSSGIS OSM car profile. Sensitivity: walking time on the FOSSGIS OSM foot profile, for the same origin-destination pairs and for the nearest walk destination when it differs. Validation: Valhalla auto time for the car pair. No paid routing service.
rationale: The project default is no paid routing. A private vehicle is a common way to move between Chiang Mai districts, and motorbikes share the road network, but the speed model is a car profile, not observed traffic and not a motorbike profile. Walking tests the assumption that a vehicle is available. Songthaew and bus timetables are not in the source set, so shared transport is not modelled. A second independent engine checks whether the car times are an artefact of one router.

choice: Report the minimum, median, mean and maximum private-vehicle times, and count district centroids at or under 30 minutes and at or under 60 minutes.
rationale: No partner has defined a single cutoff that means accessible. The spread keeps that choice visible. Thirty and sixty minutes are descriptive bins for reading the distribution. They are not a finding that a family can reach a service, and they are not weighted by the child population.
